title: ios-acceptance-workspace
responsibility: Owns the ios-acceptance-workspace build or maintenance script.

inputs.name: workspace.run
inputs.description: The acceptance run used to exercise the shared iOS workspace through the paired computer. The flow reads its record, page, and project and passes the run to restart, design, control, and layout helpers.

inputs.name: savedCopies.run
inputs.description: The acceptance run used to check saved workspace copies while the computer is suspended. The flow reads its record and page and passes the run to control, restart, design, and scrolled-layout helpers.

inputs.name: reconnection.run
inputs.description: The acceptance run used to check reconnection and revocation of the phone's workspace access. The flow reads its record and project and uses the run's simulator id for the Keychain check.

outputs.name: workspace
outputs.description: Resolves with no value after checking the shared workspace address and design, conversation modes and models, and computer lock and unlock state.

outputs.name: savedCopies
outputs.description: Resolves with no value after checking the saved cached design while the computer is away, including its read-only and comment-disabled state and scrolled layout.

outputs.name: reconnection
outputs.description: Resolves with no value after checking automatic reconnection and the current view, device online status, access revocation, unpairing after restart, and empty simulator Keychain groups.

errors.name: Page or run action rejection
errors.description: An awaited page or run action can reject the async flow; when seen catches a failed page.until check, it records a failed check and rethrows the same error.
